turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Yes.

English order: **who** (subject) + **action** (verb) + **what** (object). Time goes at the end.
Example: Sam plays football on Fridays.

Exercise: Put in order:
"usually / we / lunch / have"
(Tip: usually goes before the verb.)
